# Juarez
## SO2
```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)
library(car)
library(lmtest)
library(nortest)
library(tseries)

cad  <- read_excel("cadereyta_SE3.xlsx")
jua  <- read_excel("cadereyta_SE2.xlsx")

find_date_col <- function(df){
  cand <- grep("date|fecha|time|datetime|hora", names(df), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
  if (length(cand) == 0) stop("No se encontró una columna de fecha/hora. Renombra o agrega una.")
  cand[1]
}

DATE_COL_CAD <- find_date_col(cad)
DATE_COL_JUA <- find_date_col(jua)

parse_dt <- function(df, date_col) {
  # Intenta varios formatos comunes
  df %>%
    mutate(
      .dt_raw = .data[[date_col]],
      .dt = suppressWarnings(parse_date_time(
        .dt_raw,
        orders = c("Y-m-d H:M:S", "Y-m-d H:M", "Y-m-d",
                   "d/m/Y H:M:S", "d/m/Y H:M", "d/m/Y",
                   "Ymd HMS", "Ymd HM", "Ymd")
      ))
    )
}

cad <- parse_dt(cad, DATE_COL_CAD)
jua <- parse_dt(jua, DATE_COL_JUA)

if (all(is.na(cad$.dt))) stop("No se pudo parsear la fecha/hora en Cadereyta.")
if (all(is.na(jua$.dt))) stop("No se pudo parsear la fecha/hora en Juárez.")

# Función auxiliar: obtener el 15.º miércoles del año
nth_wednesday <- function(dt_vec, n = 15) {
  # Extraer solo las fechas (sin hora)
  dates <- lubridate::as_date(dt_vec)
  # Filtrar los miércoles
  wed_dates <- sort(unique(dates[lubridate::wday(dates, week_start = 1) == 3]))
  if (length(wed_dates) < n) stop("No hay suficientes miércoles en los datos.")
  wed_dates[n]
}

# Obtener el 15.º miércoles
WED_DT <- nth_wednesday(cad$.dt, n = 15)

# Definir rango de ese día (solo ese miércoles)
START_DT <- as.POSIXct(WED_DT, tz = lubridate::tz(cad$.dt))
END_DT   <- START_DT + lubridate::days(1)

message(sprintf("Día seleccionado: [%s, %s)", START_DT, END_DT))

# Filtrar solo los registros de ese miércoles
cad_w <- cad %>% dplyr::filter(.dt >= START_DT, .dt < END_DT)
jua_w <- jua %>% dplyr::filter(.dt >= START_DT, .dt < END_DT)

stopifnot(nrow(cad_w) > 2, nrow(jua_w) > 2)

cad_w <- cad_w %>% select(-any_of(c(DATE_COL_CAD, ".dt_raw", ".dt")))
jua_w <- jua_w %>% select(-any_of(c(DATE_COL_JUA, ".dt_raw", ".dt")))

cad_w <- cad_w %>% select(-any_of("NOX"))
jua_w <- jua_w %>% select(-any_of("NOX"))


rmse_vec <- function(truth, estimate) sqrt(mean((as.numeric(truth)-as.numeric(estimate))^2, na.rm = TRUE))
mae_vec  <- function(truth, estimate) mean(abs(as.numeric(truth)-as.numeric(estimate)), na.rm = TRUE)
rsq_vec  <- function(truth, estimate) {
  truth <- as.numeric(truth); estimate <- as.numeric(estimate)
  ss_res <- sum((truth - estimate)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  ss_tot <- sum((truth - mean(truth, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  1 - ss_res/ss_tot
}

TARGET <- "SO2"

stopifnot(TARGET %in% names(cad_w), TARGET %in% names(jua_w))

num_cols <- cad_w %>% select(where(is.numeric)) %>% names()
drop_cols <- c(TARGET, "nivel_cod", "season")  # ajusta si es necesario
x_cols <- setdiff(num_cols, drop_cols)

x_cols <- x_cols[x_cols %in% names(cad_w)]
stopifnot(length(x_cols) > 0)

sd_vec <- sapply(cad_w[x_cols], sd, na.rm = TRUE)
x_cols <- x_cols[sd_vec > 0]

if (length(x_cols) > 1) {
  cmat <- suppressWarnings(cor(cad_w[x_cols], use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
  bad_pairs <- which(abs(cmat) >= 0.99999 & upper.tri(cmat), arr.ind = TRUE)
  if (nrow(bad_pairs) > 0) {
    drop_perfect <- unique(colnames(cmat)[bad_pairs[,2]])
    x_cols <- setdiff(x_cols, drop_perfect)
  }
}
stopifnot(!(TARGET %in% x_cols), length(x_cols) > 0)

scale_stats <- cad_w %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(x_cols),
                   list(mu = \(x) mean(x, na.rm=TRUE),
                        sd = \(x) sd(x, na.rm=TRUE))))

scale_apply <- function(data, stats_tbl, cols){
  out <- data
  for (v in cols) {
    mu  <- stats_tbl[[paste0(v, "_mu")]]
    sdv <- stats_tbl[[paste0(v, "_sd")]]
    out[[v]] <- if (is.na(sdv) || sdv == 0) 0 else (out[[v]] - mu)/sdv
  }
  out
}

cad_s <- scale_apply(cad_w, scale_stats, x_cols)
jua_s <- scale_apply(jua_w, scale_stats, x_cols)

form <- as.formula(paste(TARGET, "~", paste(x_cols, collapse = " + ")))
modelo_SO2 <- lm(form, data = cad_s)
print(summary(modelo_SO2))

pred_train <- predict(modelo_SO2, newdata = cad_s)
pred_test  <- predict(modelo_SO2, newdata = jua_s)

metricas <- function(obs, pred){
  tibble(
    RMSE = rmse_vec(obs, pred),
    MAE  = mae_vec(obs, pred),
    R2   = rsq_vec(obs, pred)
  )
}

train_met <- metricas(cad_s[[TARGET]], pred_train) |> dplyr::mutate(dataset = "Cadereyta (train, 1 semana)")
test_met  <- metricas(jua_s[[TARGET]], pred_test)  |> dplyr::mutate(dataset = "Juárez (test, 1 semana)")

print(bind_rows(train_met, test_met))

print(vif(modelo_SO2))
print(bptest(modelo_SO2))
print(dwtest(modelo_SO2))

print(ad.test(resid(modelo_SO2)))
print(lillie.test(scale(resid(modelo_SO2))))
print(jarque.bera.test(resid(modelo_SO2)))

# QQ plot
res <- residuals(modelo_SO2)
qqnorm(res); qqline(res)

p_train <- tibble(obs = cad_s[[TARGET]], pred = pred_train) |>
  ggplot(aes(obs, pred)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0, linetype="dashed") +
  labs(title = "Entrenamiento: Cadereyta (1 semana)", x = "Observado", y = "Predicho")

p_test <- tibble(obs = jua_s[[TARGET]], pred = pred_test) |>
  ggplot(aes(obs, pred)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0, linetype="dashed") +
  labs(title = "Prueba: Juárez (misma semana)", x = "Observado", y = "Predicho")

p_train + p_test

```

```{r}
cad_w <- cad_w %>% select(-any_of("NOX"))
jua_w <- jua_w %>% select(-any_of("NOX"))

rmse_vec <- function(truth, estimate) sqrt(mean((as.numeric(truth)-as.numeric(estimate))^2, na.rm = TRUE))
mae_vec  <- function(truth, estimate) mean(abs(as.numeric(truth)-as.numeric(estimate)), na.rm = TRUE)
rsq_vec  <- function(truth, estimate) {
  truth <- as.numeric(truth); estimate <- as.numeric(estimate)
  ss_res <- sum((truth - estimate)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  ss_tot <- sum((truth - mean(truth, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  1 - ss_res/ss_tot
}

TARGET <- "SO2"

stopifnot(TARGET %in% names(cad_w), TARGET %in% names(jua_w))

num_cols <- cad_w %>% select(where(is.numeric)) %>% names()
drop_cols <- c(TARGET, "nivel_cod", "season")
x_cols <- setdiff(num_cols, drop_cols)

x_cols <- x_cols[x_cols %in% names(cad_w)]
stopifnot(length(x_cols) > 0)

sd_vec <- sapply(cad_w[x_cols], sd, na.rm = TRUE)
x_cols <- x_cols[sd_vec > 0]

if (length(x_cols) > 1) {
  cmat <- suppressWarnings(cor(cad_w[x_cols], use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
  bad_pairs <- which(abs(cmat) >= 0.99999 & upper.tri(cmat), arr.ind = TRUE)
  if (nrow(bad_pairs) > 0) {
    drop_perfect <- unique(colnames(cmat)[bad_pairs[,2]])
    x_cols <- setdiff(x_cols, drop_perfect)
  }
}
stopifnot(!(TARGET %in% x_cols), length(x_cols) > 0)

scale_stats <- cad_w %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(x_cols),
                   list(mu = \(x) mean(x, na.rm=TRUE),
                        sd = \(x) sd(x, na.rm=TRUE))))

scale_apply <- function(data, stats_tbl, cols){
  out <- data
  for (v in cols) {
    mu  <- stats_tbl[[paste0(v, "_mu")]]
    sdv <- stats_tbl[[paste0(v, "_sd")]]
    out[[v]] <- if (is.na(sdv) || sdv == 0) 0 else (out[[v]] - mu)/sdv
  }
  out
}

cad_s <- scale_apply(cad_w, scale_stats, x_cols)
jua_s <- scale_apply(jua_w, scale_stats, x_cols)

form <- as.formula(paste(TARGET, "~", paste(x_cols, collapse = " + ")))
modelo_SO2 <- lm(form, data = cad_s)
print(summary(modelo_SO2))

pred_train <- predict(modelo_SO2, newdata = cad_s)
pred_test  <- predict(modelo_SO2, newdata = jua_s)

metricas <- function(obs, pred){
  tibble(
    RMSE = rmse_vec(obs, pred),
    MAE  = mae_vec(obs, pred),
    R2   = rsq_vec(obs, pred)
  )
}

train_met <- metricas(cad_s[[TARGET]], pred_train) |> dplyr::mutate(dataset = "Cadereyta (train, 1 semana)")
test_met  <- metricas(jua_s[[TARGET]], pred_test)  |> dplyr::mutate(dataset = "Guadalupe (test, 1 semana)")

print(bind_rows(train_met, test_met))

print(vif(modelo_SO2))
print(bptest(modelo_SO2))
print(dwtest(modelo_SO2))

print(ad.test(resid(modelo_SO2)))
print(lillie.test(scale(resid(modelo_SO2))))
print(jarque.bera.test(resid(modelo_SO2)))

res <- residuals(modelo_SO2)
qqnorm(res); qqline(res)

p_train <- tibble(obs = cad_s[[TARGET]], pred = pred_train) |>
  ggplot(aes(obs, pred)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0, linetype="dashed") +
  labs(title = "Entrenamiento: Cadereyta (1 semana)", x = "Observado", y = "Predicho")

p_test <- tibble(obs = jua_s[[TARGET]], pred = pred_test) |>
  ggplot(aes(obs, pred)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(slope=1, intercept=0, linetype="dashed") +
  labs(title = "Prueba: Guadalupe (misma semana)", x = "Observado", y = "Predicho")

p_train + p_test

```

## PM10
```{r}
cad  <- read_excel("cadereyta_SE3.xlsx")
jua  <- read_excel("cadereyta_SE.xlsx")

find_date_col <- function(df){
  cand <- grep("date|fecha|time|datetime|hora", names(df), ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
  if (length(cand) == 0) stop("No se encontró una columna de fecha/hora. Renombra o agrega una.")
  cand[1]
}

DATE_COL_CAD <- find_date_col(cad)
DATE_COL_JUA <- find_date_col(jua)

parse_dt <- function(df, date_col) {
  df %>%
    mutate(
      .dt_raw = .data[[date_col]],
      .dt = suppressWarnings(parse_date_time(
        .dt_raw,
        orders = c("Y-m-d H:M:S", "Y-m-d H:M", "Y-m-d",
                   "d/m/Y H:M:S", "d/m/Y H:M", "d/m/Y",
                   "Ymd HMS", "Ymd HM", "Ymd")
      ))
    )
}

cad <- parse_dt(cad, DATE_COL_CAD)
jua <- parse_dt(jua, DATE_COL_JUA)

if (all(is.na(cad$.dt))) stop("No se pudo parsear la fecha/hora en Cadereyta.")
if (all(is.na(jua$.dt))) stop("No se pudo parsear la fecha/hora en Juárez.")

# Función auxiliar: obtener el 15.º miércoles del año
nth_wednesday <- function(dt_vec, n = 15) {
  # Extraer solo las fechas (sin hora)
  dates <- lubridate::as_date(dt_vec)
  # Filtrar los miércoles
  wed_dates <- sort(unique(dates[lubridate::wday(dates, week_start = 1) == 3]))
  if (length(wed_dates) < n) stop("No hay suficientes miércoles en los datos.")
  wed_dates[n]
}

# Obtener el 15.º miércoles
WED_DT <- nth_wednesday(cad$.dt, n = 15)

# Definir rango de ese día (solo ese miércoles)
START_DT <- as.POSIXct(WED_DT, tz = lubridate::tz(cad$.dt))
END_DT   <- START_DT + lubridate::days(1)

message(sprintf("Día seleccionado: [%s, %s)", START_DT, END_DT))

# Filtrar solo los registros de ese miércoles

jua_w <- jua %>% dplyr::filter(.dt >= START_DT, .dt < END_DT)

stopifnot(nrow(cad_w) > 2, nrow(jua_w) > 2)

cad_w <- cad_w %>% select(-any_of(c(DATE_COL_CAD, ".dt_raw", ".dt")))
jua_w <- jua_w %>% select(-any_of(c(DATE_COL_JUA, ".dt_raw", ".dt")))

cad_w <- cad_w %>% select(-any_of("NOX"))
jua_w <- jua_w %>% select(-any_of("NOX"))

rmse_vec <- function(truth, estimate) sqrt(mean((as.numeric(truth)-as.numeric(estimate))^2, na.rm = TRUE))
mae_vec  <- function(truth, estimate) mean(abs(as.numeric(truth)-as.numeric(estimate)), na.rm = TRUE)
rsq_vec  <- function(truth, estimate) {
  truth <- as.numeric(truth); estimate <- as.numeric(estimate)
  ss_res <- sum((truth - estimate)^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  ss_tot <- sum((truth - mean(truth, na.rm = TRUE))^2, na.rm = TRUE)
  1 - ss_res/ss_tot
}

TARGET <- "PM10"

stopifnot(TARGET %in% names(cad_w), TARGET %in% names(jua_w))

num_cols <- cad_w %>% select(where(is.numeric)) %>% names()
drop_cols <- c(TARGET, "nivel_cod", "season")
x_cols <- setdiff(num_cols, drop_cols)

x_cols <- x_cols[x_cols %in% names(cad_w)]
stopifnot(length(x_cols) > 0)

stopifnot(!(TARGET %in% x_cols), length(x_cols) > 0)

                   list(mu = \(x) mean(x, na.rm=TRUE),

scale_apply <- function(data, stats_tbl, cols){
  out <- data
  for (v in cols) {
    mu  <- stats_tbl[[paste0(v, "_mu")]]
    sdv <- stats_tbl[[paste0(v, "_sd")]]
```
